instance.selection: Use target/environment mapping in owner SKILL; never enumerate unrelated profiles or silently fall back.
instance.currentVersion: unknown; historical values are not runtime evidence
instance.addressEvidence: Owner SKILL.md environment tables are the address SSOT; credential variables and exceptions in auth.nativeCredentialPath are selected-instance constraints.

auth.nativeCredentialPath: Official gcloud selected existing account/configuration + explicit --project; CLI credentials distinct from ADC.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: gcloud auth login for selected account, browser human interaction/no-launch-browser supported. ADC auth application-default login only for SDK need; do not silently change other accounts/configs.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: Selected gcloud auth list metadata and gcloud projects describe <target> with explicit account/project; active email is local metadata, server IAM/resource access still needs read probe.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: gcloud auth revoke selected account for user credential; ADC separately revoked. Service-account keys only approved injection and IAM disable/delete by admin; no printing access tokens.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.
